reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below $64,650 - held UNCHANGED for a NINTH consecutive session. It is now further from price than at any point this week: spot 64,961.3 gives 311.3 points of clearance, 0.48%, roughly two tenths of a daily ATR. The line keeps its place because the structure underneath it has not moved - the daily EMA50 sits at 64,674.3, the 1H EMA100 at 64,675.8, the 4H EMA20 at 64,737.0, and the 64,750 realized-liquidation pocket sits just above all three. A settled hourly close beneath 64,650 would put price under every one of them in a single move and would also invalidate the eight-hour sequence of higher lows that defines this morning's entire bullish case.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above $65,000, WITH open interest flat or rising across the same bar. The trigger is raised from midnight's 64,920 because that level has now done its job: the 10:00Z bar settled at 64,955.7, comfortably above it. 65,000 is the next honest test - it is a round number, it is the second realized-liquidation pocket on the tape at $26,815, and the session high since the midnight stamp is 64,999.9, which is to say price has touched it to within a tenth of a point and been turned away once already. The open-interest condition is not decoration: it is the exact lesson the 08 Aug endday session wrote down after the 65,120 break failed, where OI FELL 0.87% while price rose and the move turned out to be short covering with no fuel behind it.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD for a second consecutive session, but the reasoning has been upgraded from anticipatory to confirmed and the add trigger has been RAISED 80 points from 64,920 to 65,000. Midnight bought a starter tranche at 64,852 on the argument that the long flush had been absorbed and the shelf had held; it left 22.38 USDT dry and named the precise condition for the rest - a confirmed reclaim above 64,920. That condition has now half-fired. One settled hourly close is above the level, the second confirming bar is live and currently trading above it, and open interest ROSE 0.43% to $2.0183B across the same move, which is the opposite signature to the failed break of 08 August. The reduce line is untouched at 64,650 for a ninth session.

liquidation.note: Still the dominant cluster on the tape and now the best-defended level on the chart. Bucketing all 109 fills from OKX /public/liquidation-orders over the 2026-08-08T12:03:42Z to 2026-08-09T10:01:43Z window into 250-USD bands (BTC-USDT-SWAP contract multiplier 0.01 BTC), the 64,750 band carries $262,332 of the $315,111 total - 83% of everything liquidated in 21 hours 58 minutes concentrated in one 250-point pocket across 75 separate fills. What changed since midnight is the composition, and it changed for the better. Midnight read this band as $96,291 of long liquidations against $8,200 of shorts, a one-sided long flush. The full window now reads $118,165 long against $144,167 short. Shorts were carried out on the bounce off 64,722.7 in larger size than the longs were on the way down. A level that liquidates BOTH sides is not a trapdoor, it is a shelf that has been swept clean in both directions, and that is the strongest argument this report has for why 64,722.7 held.

$26,815 across 15 fills, $10,214 long and $16,601 short. Small in absolute terms but it sits 38.7 points above spot and is the nearest magnet in either direction, which makes it the level price is currently being drawn into. The session high since the midnight stamp is 64,999.9 - price has already probed to within a tenth of a point of this pocket and been rejected once this morning.

$25,964 across 19 fills and, unusually, 100% SHORT liquidations with zero longs. This is the residue of the failed push toward 65,388 earlier in the window - shorts that were squeezed out on the way up and never got a matching long flush on the way back down. It means the leverage that was leaning against a move to 65,250 has already been removed once, which cuts both ways: less fuel for a squeeze, but also less resistance from stubborn short size.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull reads UP on distance rather than on size, and the distinction is worth stating plainly. The 64,750 pocket is roughly ten times larger than the 65,000 pocket, but it sits 211.3 points below spot while 65,000 sits 38.7 points above, and price has spent the last five hours walking toward the nearer one. The counterweight is positioning: the OKX long/short account ratio is 1.21, up from 1.20 at midnight, so retail longs are marginally more crowded than they were, and crowded longs are what feed a move back down into the larger pocket. Read together, the honest description is a market being drawn up into a small magnet while carrying the ingredients for a fast trip to the big one if 64,784.9 gives way.

divergences.note: Price rose 109.3 points between the midnight read and this one while the 4H MACD histogram deepened from -25.45 to -37.31. Higher price against a lower oscillator is a textbook bearish divergence on the intermediate frame, and it is the single strongest argument against sizing this morning's add aggressively. Two qualifications keep it from dominating the report. First, it is a histogram divergence, not a price-versus-RSI divergence - 4H RSI actually ROSE from the midnight read to 55.34, so the two momentum measures disagree with each other. Second, the 4H MACD line at 219.24 is still deeply positive and merely converging toward its 256.55 signal from above; this is a decelerating uptrend on that frame, not a reversal already in progress. Treated as a size constraint rather than a directional signal.

calibration.rollingRecord: 59 rows on file before this one. The 09 Aug midnight session called range with a bullish tilt at 34/46/20 from 64,852.0, held position at ADD, held the reduce at 64,650 for an eighth session, set the add trigger at 64,920 and deployed 14 of 36.38 USDT of free cash into spot. Every one of those five decisions has scored correctly so far. The bullish tilt was right in direction: price is 64,961.3, up 109.3 points or 0.169%. Holding 64,650 was right and comfortably so - the lowest trade since is 64,784.9, so the line was never approached within 134 points, let alone tested. The 64,920 add trigger was well placed rather than lucky: it was set 68 points above the then-spot, price took eight hours to reach it, and the 10:00Z bar settled at 64,955.7 to fire the first leg. And the starter tranche is in profit - 14 USDT bought at a 64,852.0 mark is worth 14.024 at 64,961.3. The one thing midnight got wrong in emphasis rather than in direction was the liquidation read: it described the 64,750 pocket as a one-sided long flush at $96,291 long against $8,200 short, and the completed window shows $118,165 long against $144,167 short. Shorts were carried out at that level in larger size than longs. That makes the shelf stronger than midnight argued, not weaker, so the error ran in the wallet's favour.
calibration.note: The reduce level at 64,650 has now survived nine consecutive sessions without a settled hourly close beneath it, and this session is the first in which it was not tested at all. That is a level earning its keep. The open question the desk has been carrying since 08 August is whether a break through a trigger is bought by new money or by shorts covering, and this run finally has the clean answer the endday session asked for: open interest ROSE 0.43% while price rose 0.17%. That is new positioning arriving, not old positioning unwinding.
